title: KPI module with GET /api/v1/kpis
story: As a supervisor or carrier admin I can see per-tenant operational KPIs tied to value drivers for a date range.
acceptance: src/modules/kpi/index.mjs exports module {name:'kpi', migrations?, init, service(ctx), routes} following the module shape of src/modules/coverage/index.mjs; GET /api/v1/kpis?from&to returns {period:{from,to}, metrics:[{id,label,valueDriver,value,unit,numerator,denominator}]}; 400 on invalid dates or from>to; defaults to last 30 days

Metrics present with ids and drivers: stp_rate (VD-1), automated_capture_rate (VD-1), median_minutes_to_acknowledgment and median_minutes_to_assignment (VD-2), coverage_verified_at_intake_rate and fraud_flag_rate (VD-4), subrogation_flag_rate (VD-5), digital_self_service_share and spanish_session_share (VD-6), regulatory_timers_met and regulatory_timers_breached (VD-7)
Zero-denominator metrics return value null (not NaN) with numerator/denominator reported; medians return null when no data
Allowed roles supervisor, tenant_admin, carrier_admin, auditor; csr/adjuster/claimant get 403; results are computed only from the caller tenant (tenant isolation test with two tenants)
Computation reads data only via tenant-bound ctx.modules service functions or tenant-scoped reads of outbox; no PII in output; no writes

tests/unit/kpi/*.test.mjs pass with a fixture tenant (known counts and expected values for every metric) using small local fakes for claims/triage/routing/timers/outbox: node --test --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/unit/kpi/*.test.mjs
brief: Build a new module src/modules/kpi/ (REQ-23): index.mjs (module def, routes), service.mjs (compute(period) using the tenant-bound ctx), metrics.mjs (pure metric functions over normalised inputs, easy to unit test), and routes.mjs. Read core-runtime-api.md (tenant-bound ctx addendum) and mimic src/modules/coverage/index.mjs for registration. Inputs: claims in the period (claims service getters; discover the available list/query fn in src/modules/claims/service.mjs and use only documented service functions, with graceful fallback if one is missing), triage (getLatestTriage: fraud and subrogation flags), routing (rules.getRoutingDecision: fast_track/STP and assignment time), timers (claims.listTimers: met vs breached), evidence accepted facts (provenance ai_extraction for automated capture), coverage.getLatestVerification, and outbox events via ctx.bus.outbox(tenantId) filtered by time for claim.acknowledged / claim.assigned / claim.reported timestamps. Definitions: STP = claims fast-tracked and closed or routed with no manual task / total claims; automated capture = claims with at least one accepted AI-extracted fact / claims; median minutes report to acknowledgment/assignment from event times; digital self-service = claims with channel in web/mobile/chat without csr actor / claims; Spanish share = intake sessions or claims with locale es* / total. State each definition in a METRIC_DEFS constant exposed in the result docs. Keep each metric computation failure isolated (one failing source yields value null plus a note, not a 500). Do not invent new events. Tests: tests/unit/kpi/metrics.test.mjs (pure), service.test.mjs (fixture tenant with fakes), routes.test.mjs (roles, validation, isolation). Run with a glob, not a directory (Node 22). Post any contract gaps to the architecture hub as contract-change and document additions; use the smallest compatible choice. Do not edit package.json (platform team registers modules by directory scan; if not, post a request).

verdicts.reason: All criteria met, 25/25 unit tests pass; only regression-gate failure is openapi role-matrix snapshot drift (openapi/architecture change, not KPI files)
